text: Incident OPS-101: Prometheus scrape reported doubled llm_llm_ metric prefixes and counted reranker yes/no decisions under an output-token counter. Remediation renamed counters to llm_tokens_input_total and llm_rerank_scored_docs_total.

Incident OPS-102: Background ingest crashed after committing LanceDB rows but before committing Tantivy segments. Recovery detected the uncommitted .ingest_journal.json file, reconciled both stores to a matching generation, and restored HTTP 200 readiness.
